visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a montage of archival news footage showing a commercial pig farming facility. A blue truck and several white service vehicles are parked near a galvanized steel fence. In the background, tall leafy trees and a dense forest line are visible under a bright but overcast grey sky. Several figures in full white chemical protection suits and masks appear briefly near a gate, indicating an active quarantine or investigation scene. (2) The scene shifts to a professional studio environment where a young Asian man, identified as the host, is framed in a medium close-up shot. He has well-groomed, medium-length dark brown hair and is wearing a stylish black blazer with thin white pinstripes over a simple white t-shirt. He speaks with an engaged expression, looking directly into the lens, and uses dynamic hand gestures to emphasize his points against a dark, minimalist background featuring a clapperboard graphic. (3) A digital screenshot of a news article or government bulletin is displayed as a full-screen graphic. The headline, written in traditional Chinese, focuses on the detection of African Swine Fever (ASF). The page is predominantly white with a sidebar of links and a timestamp. A bright yellow banner at the bottom of the frame provides a constant graphic element, containing social media handles and call-to-action text in black. (4) Returning to the host in the studio, the visual composition includes floating text boxes that appear to his left. Large, bold white numbers such as "800 億" and "2000 億" appear against dark semi-transparent backgrounds to illustrate economic impact. The host points toward these graphics with his right hand while maintaining eye contact with the viewer, his movements synchronized with the information being presented on screen. (5) The host continues his presentation, and the video utilizes on-screen list-style graphics. Three distinct yellow rectangular panels with rounded corners slide into the frame, each containing a question or a point of controversy related to the government's response. The lighting on the host is bright and directional, creating clear highlights on his face and hair, while the background remains softly out of focus to keep the attention on the speaker. (6) The final sequence features a change in visual style where three large yellow speech bubbles with bold black question marks appear in the center of the frame. The host remains visible in a smaller window at the bottom, concluding his remarks. The background transitions to a patterned yellow surface. The video ends with a persistent yellow footer bar that includes a channel logo and a play button icon for further viewing.
